propositions: Pydantic AI 1.107.2 structured-output seams must preserve Rebar's existing behavior for deterministic repair, schema/sentinel extraction, three-attempt ceiling, stop-reason fast-fail, and provider fallback ordering without accidental deltas.

One operation-wide Pydantic request_limit must govern both tool turns and output-validation retries, with an approved documented caveat to raise the limit if legitimate recovery is starved by the shared ceiling.

Failed intermediate responses must be sent complete on retry only when deterministic fit is proven; otherwise omit them whole from retry context without prefix truncation, and never mutate Agent history or final-failure artifacts.

Successful output retry must aggregate all consumed requests and tokens into a single operation row per outer Rebar run, and failed exhaustion must re-raise only the exact Rebar-owned output error found in Pydantic's cause chain.

Candidate fallback and mode-downgrade attempts must remain bounded by explicit candidate chain and predicate, with logical-attempt observability emitted as trace events rather than synthesized into core usage or pricing.
All Phase-4 decisions are approved and RP-01 is ready for implementation ticketization; no accidental behavioral delta has been left to the implementer.
